gemini.title: NaPTAN Bus Stops
gemini.abstract: Point locations and reference attributes for bus stops from the National Public Transport Access Nodes dataset, including national identifiers, passenger-facing names, locality hierarchy, stop classifications, timing status and record lifecycle information.
gemini.lineage: Published by Department for Transport as open transport data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.

columns.name: atcocode
columns.description: Unique national ATCO identifier for the stop point.

columns.name: naptancode
columns.description: Short public-facing NaPTAN code printed or displayed for the stop.

columns.name: platecode
columns.description: Local code shown on the physical stop plate where supplied.

columns.name: cleardowncode
columns.description: Code used by some operators to clear or identify the stop in operational systems.

columns.name: commonname
columns.description: Primary name by which the stop is publicly known.

columns.name: commonnamelang
columns.description: Language code for the primary stop name.

columns.name: shortcommonname
columns.description: Abbreviated public name for the stop where supplied.

columns.name: shortcommonnamelang
columns.description: Language code for the abbreviated stop name.

columns.name: landmark
columns.description: Nearby landmark used to help passengers locate the stop.

columns.name: landmarklang
columns.description: Language code for the landmark text.

columns.name: street
columns.description: Street or road on which the stop is located.

columns.name: streetlang
columns.description: Language code for the street name.

columns.name: crossing
columns.description: Nearby crossing or intersecting street used to describe the stop location.

columns.name: crossinglang
columns.description: Language code for the crossing description.

columns.name: indicator
columns.description: Location indicator distinguishing the stop, such as a stand, bay, direction or outside landmark.

columns.name: indicatorlang
columns.description: Language code for the stop indicator.

columns.name: bearing
columns.description: Compass direction faced or served by the stop, such as N, SW or E.

columns.name: nptglocalitycode
columns.description: National Public Transport Gazetteer code for the stop's locality.

columns.name: localityname
columns.description: NPTG locality name associated with the stop.

columns.name: parentlocalityname
columns.description: Name of the parent locality containing the stop locality.

columns.name: grandparentlocalityname
columns.description: Name of the higher-level locality containing the parent locality.

columns.name: town
columns.description: Town or settlement recorded for the stop location.

columns.name: townlang
columns.description: Language code for the town name, such as EN.

columns.name: suburb
columns.description: Suburb or neighbourhood recorded for the stop.

columns.name: suburblang
columns.description: Language code for the suburb name.

columns.name: localitycentre
columns.description: Boolean indicator showing whether the stop represents a locality centre.

columns.name: gridtype
columns.description: Coordinate grid system used for the stop location, such as UKOS.

columns.name: easting
columns.description: Easting coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.

columns.name: northing
columns.description: Northing coordinate in metres in the dataset's projected coordinate reference system.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude coordinate, normally expressed in decimal degrees.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude coordinate, normally expressed in decimal degrees.

columns.name: stoptype
columns.description: NaPTAN stop-classification code identifying the transport stop or access-point type.

columns.name: busstoptype
columns.description: NaPTAN bus-stop subtype, such as marked, hail-and-ride, flexible or unmarked.

columns.name: timingstatus
columns.description: Operational timing-point status used in public transport scheduling.

columns.name: defaultwaittime
columns.description: Default interchange waiting time recorded for the stop.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Additional publisher note about the stop record.

columns.name: noteslang
columns.description: Language code for the stop notes.

columns.name: administrativeareacode
columns.description: NPTG administrative-area code responsible for the stop record.

columns.name: creationdatetime
columns.description: Date and time when the stop record was created.

columns.name: modificationdatetime
columns.description: Date and time when the stop record was last modified.

columns.name: revisionnumber
columns.description: Revision sequence number of the NaPTAN record.

columns.name: modification
columns.description: Change action represented by the record, such as new, revise or delete.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Lifecycle status of the stop record, such as active, inactive or pending.

columns.name: stop_pk
columns.description: Internal primary-key value for the imported stop record.

columns.name: geom
columns.description: Spatial geometry of the represented feature.
